cvEn: Aharon (Aharoni) Shulbaum, son of Tzila and Yosef, was born on 24 Tammuz 5695 (25 July 1935) in Jerusalem. After studying at the Real School in Haifa until 1950, he continued his studies at the Agricultural High School in Pardes Hanna, where he completed his studies in 1955. In August of that year he was drafted into the IDF. On 23 Elul 5716 (30 August 1956), he was killed while carrying out his duties when he stepped on a landmine, and he was laid to rest in the military cemetery in Haifa.
